lead: Adam Gilchrist has built a public profile as an Australian cricketer, born on 14 November 1969 in Bellingen.
As of 2026, he is 56 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has represented New South Wales cricket team and Australia national cricket team and has been recognised with Wisden Cricketer of the Year and Member of the Order of Australia.
This profile collects the Adam facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Adam Gilchrist — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Adam Gilchrist was born on 14 November 1969 in Bellingen, and holds Australian nationality.
He received his education at Kadina High School.

sections.heading: Adam Gilchrist — Career and Professional Work
paras: Adam Gilchrist works primarily as a cricketer.

On the team sheet, Adam has been associated with New South Wales cricket team, Australia national cricket team (from 1999 to 2008), Western Australia cricket team (from 1994 to 2008), Deccan Chargers (from 2008 to 2010), Middlesex County Cricket Club (from 2010 to 2010) and Punjab Kings (from 2011 to 2013).
He has taken part in 1998 Commonwealth Games.
